scenes.alt: The same torn bag is already supported on a stationary tray at an ordinary repair workbench. A close pair of hands attends to the strap; a completed illustrated seam replaces the break. A brief fade cuts to a later supported view of the same repaired bag beside its owner, retaining the paid receipt; this is a view transition, not a physically hand-carried transfer. The conceptual shopping terminal keeps an empty new-bag basket, so its distributing platform has no sale-linked commission entry. Useful repair and economic activity persist while one funding model loses its transaction.
